core_claims: Shared W ties parameter templates in a fixed architecture/checkpoint; private factors and nonlinear trajectories can change effective directions, scales, signs and activation regions.
Arbitrary independent member channel permutations are not generically symmetries of one shared-W/diagonal-factor family; only architecture-compatible common permutations are claimed.
Consecutive fully factorized affine ReLU layers admit qualified private positive scaling transport; this gauge has not been established for the actual Amazon boundary-only factor adapter.
Fixed independent channel permutations preserve the full exported bank information and can be exactly absorbed into the first linear map of a concatenation head.
Member identity across nodes differs from hidden-channel identity across members.
Mean plus labeled centered contrasts reconstructs the whole bank; mean plus variance is generally lossy.
Symmetric same-channel pair-product sums are determined by mean and second moment; all structured summaries remain deterministic functions of the bank.
High linear CKA is compatible with separately permuted/orthogonally transformed channels and isotropic scaling; it is not a same-channel, information or error-complementarity certificate.
For Z=phi(H,Q,T), conditional data processing bounds summary information by the bank. Optimal unrestricted log-loss improvement over Q is I(Y;H|Q,T); no quantity estimated.
Predictive ties can still permit measured sample/head/alignment/storage efficiency benefits; no efficiency or quality gain observed.

one_decisive_control.operator: Regularized nonlinear concatenation/readout on the exact complete fixed-depth bank
one_decisive_control.containment: Include the exact structured candidate as a zero-residual branch if generic exact representability is not demonstrated; disclose budget tradeoff.
one_decisive_control.interpretation: Win supports bank/budget-specific inductive bias; tie/loss rejects special structured aggregation utility on that bank. Cross-family effects do not isolate alignment.

optional_diagnostic: Fixed per-member channel permutation across all nodes/roles with analytic concat weight reindexing; summary change diagnoses coordinate dependence only. No new search grid.

actual_adapter.private_factors: stem and local/global BoundaryProjector heads only
actual_adapter.internal_body: shared GAT/linear branches, products, LayerNorm, gates, cumulative state and optional global attention
actual_adapter.raw_vs_effective_head_input: h versus h*R[member] must be declared
actual_adapter.same_depth_requirement: One actual named common interface for every checkpoint; selected local/global stages can differ across independent members.
